Speech-to-text
only when no harness transcript exists

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Image understanding
hint: open slot names of the goal, if known
otherwise generic extraction

div.style: color: rgb(11, 27, 63) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Immediate acknowledgement
names the modality and purpose
'Looking at the display in your photo'

div.style: color: rgb(11, 27, 63) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
ONE text path for typed and spoken input
fast understanding → slot values

div.style: color: rgb(11, 27, 63) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Evidence keyed by FRAME
claims = image facts + confidence
attached to the turn it arrived in → that turn's goal

div.style: color: rgb(11, 27, 63) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Slot needs a value
that an attached frame claims?

div.style: color: rgb(11, 27, 63) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Write slot · last writer wins
writer = input sequence for text,
frame sequence for evidence
newest frame wins per claim

div.style: color: rgb(61, 42, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
CONFLICT or LOW CONFIDENCE
evidence ≠ user statement · transcript ≠ audio
→ specific clarification naming the options
→ state-changing tools BLOCKED on that slot

div.style: color: rgb(107, 114, 128) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Frame attached to a SUSPENDED goal
evidence kept, not applied to the new goal
no speech about it
